name: context_get
description: Read backend-owned assistant context for this turn; IDs remain valid when picker is closed.

name: database_schema
description: Inspect application schema on a separate read-only connection; settings values and credentials are omitted.

name: database_query
description: Run one bounded read-only SELECT, WITH, or EXPLAIN query. Writes, ATTACH/DETACH, dangerous PRAGMAs, extensions, and credential-bearing settings are denied; truncation metadata is explicit.

name: history_search
description: Search the entire history using the picker's native case-insensitive query grammar, independent of selection or visible items. Follow returned cursors until exhausted before claiming all matches. Set includeContent=true to summarize matching clips; previews can be truncated.

query.description: Empty matches all history. Plain text searches content and metadata. Use 'in:metadata <term>' or 'in:title,notes,tags <term>' for title/notes/tags only; 'in:content <term>' for body only. Metadata matching does not include body-only matches.

name: history_get
description: Read one history item by decimal ID, optionally including text.

name: history_create
description: Create or merge a text item through normal storage validation.

name: history_update
description: Update one existing item by ID; only supplied patch fields change.

name: history_remove
description: Remove one exact history item and its associated blobs.

name: history_promote
description: Promote one item using normal copy-order semantics.

name: image_read
description: Read the original image blob as an actual data URL, never a thumbnail.

name: picker_focus
description: Open the resident picker with an unfiltered history and focus one existing item after the renderer confirms selection. Never copies, pastes, reorders, or creates items; use history_promote first when the item should be first.

name: tags_list
description: List known metadata tags through the product API.

name: export_text
description: Export text to an exact target path with create-new semantics; never overwrites.

name: export_image
description: Export the original image blob to an exact target path with create-new semantics; never overwrites.

name: action_list
description: List discovered built-in and script actions without private source paths.

name: action_run
description: Run one discovered action through the normal validating action gateway. Scripts are trusted runtime code. Result verification contains only script-reported boolean checks, integer counts and item IDs, or null when no verification was returned. Completed execution alone does not prove the requested outcome; use post-write read-back checks. False checks or invalid reports fail the action and stop this assistant turn before any further tools or provider requests; prior effects are not rolled back.

name: script_save
description: Save a named trusted TypeScript/JavaScript action without overwrite and register it. A clipboardChange trigger enables ongoing automatic execution and requires explicit activateClipboardChange=true approval.

activateClipboardChange.description: Explicitly authorize ongoing automatic execution when this source declares a clipboardChange trigger. Omit or false for manually invoked scripts.

name: api_describe
description: Read the shipped copicu-action TypeScript declarations for the supported host API and manifest shape.
